expectedIssues: Promo banner text is unreadable, white text on a pale mint background
reportedIssues: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is rendered in white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast. The headline and especially the promo code are barely readable, so users may miss the offer or the code.
Within the same washed-out banner, the white 'Order now' button blends with the pale background and the surrounding white text, weakening the visual hierarchy of the call to action.
Secondary metadata such as '€0.90 delivery' and '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' uses light grey text that is lower contrast against the white background.
